name: Weighted sequence order, non-repeat completion, repeat wrap and hierarchy retain all intermediate histories
Live counts, entry identity/order, array replacement and type/child edits refresh the selected work
Backpressure and snapshot restore preserve active Source and its position in a counted entry
Large quantity avoids expanded arrays and produces exactly the same small executed prefix
Invalid Source counts still report validation errors, and checked legacy data retains RangeError behavior
Engine update detects direct count edits and reset clears pending events
